description: Configure state, year-built, and condition filters to extract US bridge inventory records from the FHWA's official National Bridge Inventory (2026 SNBI edition).

conditionCategory.description: Filter by the FHWA bridge condition classification (Good / Fair / Poor, 23 CFR 490) calculated in the source data.
conditionCategory.title: Bridge Condition

maxItems.description: Maximum number of bridge records to extract.
maxItems.title: Max Bridges

minYearBuilt.description: Only bridges built in or after this year. 0 means no year filter.
minYearBuilt.title: Minimum Year Built (0 = Any)

states.description: Two-letter US state / territory codes to include (e.g. ["DE", "TX"]), as listed on the FHWA 2026 NBI download page. Empty means all listed states and territories.
states.title: States (Optional)

title: US Bridge Inventory Input
